name: WeekHack

sources.title: Pricing — Free Launch $0 (product page + voting; dofollow only if top-3; next available week 'a few weeks to a couple of months'); Premium $19 one-time guarantees dofollow + chosen week
Submit route — behind sign-in (Google, GitHub, or email account required)

conditions: Free launches go into the 'next available week' queue — 'a few weeks to a couple of months' depending on demand
Free listings only earn a dofollow backlink by finishing top-3 in their week — otherwise the link is nofollow
Free relaunch cooldown is 1 year (Premium: 30 days)
requirements: A shippable product/side project — weekly launch board for makers
Free: product listing page, community voting/comments, next-available-week slot
Premium $19 one-time: pick launch week, skip review queue, homepage feature, guaranteed permanent dofollow
Optional power-ups during submission: 50+ directory submissions $99, expert review article $99, social promo $199
AI-assisted import: paste website or Product Hunt link to prefill the launch form
preparation: Website or Product Hunt URL for the AI prefill
Screenshots and product details to fine-tune the listing
Decide free vs $19 Premium (dofollow guarantee) before submitting
workflow: Paste site/PH URL to prefill; edit screenshots and details
Choose Free (queue) or Premium ($19, pick your week)
Review → published in your launch week; community voting opens
Free tier: finish top-3 to earn the dofollow link
watchFor: Free-link value is performance-dependent — most free listings will end up nofollow
Queue delay for free tier can be months — plan launch timing accordingly
No refunds once a launch week is confirmed
Upsell-heavy flow (directory-submission and promo add-ons up to $199)
countsAsLive: The product appears on weekhack.com/launches with a dedicated page, open community voting, and a launch-week slot
unknowns: Review criteria / what gets rejected in the free queue
How many products compete per weekly cohort
